Grand Rapids case study
As firefighters at Grand Rapids Fire Department confronted a dangerous rise in close calls on the road, HAAS Alert approached the station to help it develop a new solution that would become Safety Cloud. Learn how their partnership helped to develop the industry standard in digital alerting for public safety.
Read the full Grand Rapids case study to learn:
How the Grand Rapids Fire Department was having a frightening amount of close calls on the road with their personnel
How HAAS Alert approached Grand Rapids to help develop Safety Cloud
The features that Safety Cloud has been able to add and perfect thanks to in the field work with the Grand Rapids Fire Department.
